name: Arikara
summary: Magatha Grimtotem sends a warning from Thunder Bluff: Arikara may be hunting High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. She sends Horde adventurers to summon and slay the ancient wind serpent on the burial spires of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Beast in the Smoke
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem enchants the refined Incendia powder, a reagent, to call Arikara. She warns that ancient tauren traditions have changed too quickly under the new Horde alliance, stirring the vengeance of the ferocious wind serpent spirit. Magatha sends you south to the canyon of Thousand Needles. She tells you to cast the powder onto a ritual pyre among the elevated burial sites of Darkcloud Pinnacle.

sections.title: Doubt at Whitereach Post
sections.body: After you slay Arikara on the burial needle and claim its skin, you bring the remains to Motega Firemane at Whitereach Post. Motega is bewildered, finding it hard to believe that a primal spirit would bear malice toward Cairne Bloodhoof. He sets his doubts aside rather than openly question Magatha, the tribe's most powerful shaman, and rewards you for protecting the chieftain.

faq.answer: Arikara is a powerful wind serpent summoned atop Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles. Magatha says modern departures from traditional tauren lore stirred the beast to vengeance.

faq.q: Why does Magatha Grimtotem want Arikara dead?
faq.answer: Magatha says Arikara is hunting Cairne Bloodhoof, the High Chieftain of the tauren. She sends you to destroy the serpent with enchanted Incendia powder before it can threaten Thunder Bluff's leader.

faq.q: Where is the sacred fire located to summon her?
faq.answer: The unlit sacred fire of life stands atop an isolated spire within Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles, where local tauren bury their dead.

faq.q: Why is Motega Firemane skeptical of the hunt?
faq.answer: Magatha fears Arikara may be stalking Cairne and asks you to bring proof of the hunt to Motega. Motega's response comes when you deliver the remains.

faq.q: Is Cairne actually in danger from Arikara?
faq.answer: Magatha says she fears Arikara may be stalking Cairne. Her warning calls for action, but does not establish the danger independently.

faq.q: What is the previous quest in this chain?
faq.answer: This story follows "Sacred Fire," when adventurers gather Incendia Agave from the Boiling Pool in Thousand Needles for Magatha Grimtotem to enchant into Incendia powder.

angles.text: For you as a tauren, the story touches on tension between ancestral rites and political shifts under Cairne Bloodhoof's leadership, with the Grimtotem caught in the matter.
As a shaman, you can see the friction between elemental ritual and political intrigue, and Motega's reluctance to challenge Magatha's spiritual authority.
As a member of the Horde, you march into Thousand Needles to neutralize any threat to Cairne Bloodhoof, the venerable High Chieftain you are sworn to protect.
